div.head: Wl art retr 3.1
div.ab: Et si quis de illis occisus fuerit, dominus eius habeat intra quinque dies homicidam eius, si potuerit; sin autem, incipiat persoluere nobis XLVI marcas argenti, quamdiu substantia domini illius perdurauerit.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 490 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page); Robertson does not print this clause separately; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “c. 1210 (Liebermann)”, now “c.1210 (Liebermann, I p. 489; Robertson)”)
